picks.title: Rehumanising science | Carlo Rovelli - Part 2
picks.summary: What makes humans different from nature? What do Confucianism and Daoism have to do with physics? Is science too realist?In part 2 of our interview with Carlo Rovelli, we help unpick the history of the philosophy of science. picks.reason: Explores Daoism and Confucianism's relation to science and human nature.

picks.title: Sitting With Your Karma
picks.summary: Given at a One-Day Sitting at the Boulder Zen Center, this talk picks up a question left open in the previous episode, "Sitting Like a Buddha." If zazen is not a means to awakening but its enactment, what about karma? Thoughts, fragments of story, and small triggers of dissatisfaction keep arriving, and we assume awakening means their absence. The talk proposes instead that we are always sitting and living with our karma; what changes is our relationship to it. picks.reason: Zen talk on living with karma and awakening as relationship change.
